label: Begin
content:
PDF to Paligo Instructions

  1. Create a new topic in Paligo, in the appropriate folder (02 - Publications -> <product>).
  2. Open the topic in the editor.
  3. Open the PDF-XML tool in a new window on a different monitor.

label: Extract text
content:
For text (paragraphs)

  1. In Paligo, select the source view icon (</>).
  2. Place your cursor after the closing title tag </title> and before the closing section tag </section>.
    You can delete the <para>placeholder</para> text.
    If your topic has content already, place the cursor right in front of the last </section> tag.
  3. Switch to the PDF-XML tool.
  4. Select the Paragraph card.
  5. Upload the PDF or continue with the one already loaded.
  6. Enter the Page number and select Show page.
  7. Draw a region around the paragraph.
  8. Select Extract.
  9. Preview the text to ensure it is correct.
  10. Select Copy all to copy the XML from the text box.
  11. Switch back to your open topic in Paligo.
  12. Paste the XML into the Paligo topic, immediately before the section close </section>.
  13. Click Update.
  14. View the results to verify.
  15. Click Save to save the Paligo topic.

label: Extract tables
content:
For tables

  1. In Paligo, select the source view icon (</>).
  2. Place your cursor after the closing title tag </title> and before the closing section tag </section>.
    You can delete the <para>placeholder</para> text.
  3. Switch to the PDF-XML tool.
  4. Select the Table card.
  5. Upload the PDF, or continue with the one already loaded.
  6. Enter the Page number and select Show page.
  7. Draw a region around the table.
  8. Select Extract. A header row is added automatically when the tool can tell the table has one.
  9. Verify the table appearance, then copy the XML.
  10. Switch back to your open topic in Paligo.
  11. Paste the XML into the Paligo topic.
  12. Select Update.

label: Extract images
content:
Extract an image

Extract an image, save it to disk, then upload it to Paligo. This step requires Paligo to be open in the WYSIWYG editor, not the XML view.

In the PDF-XML tool

  1. Select the Image card.
  2. Upload the PDF, or continue with the one already loaded.
  3. Enter the Page number and select Show page. The preview renders at high resolution so the crop comes out clean.
  4. Draw a region around the image.
  5. Select Extract. The image opens in a new window.
  6. Right-click the image and select Save as.

    Use the correct file name format.
    <product>_<image_type>descriptive_name/partno.
    sentinel_ill_ecubracket_400-5320Y1.png

In Paligo

  1. Switch to your Paligo topic.
  2. Select Insert -> Image -> Image.
  3. Open the correct folder in the Media browser.
  4. Select Add files.
  5. Select the downloaded image.
  6. Select Upload.
  7. The image will be placed in the topic.

label: Extract lists
content:
For tables

  1. In Paligo, select the source view icon (</>).
  2. Place your cursor after the closing title tag </title> and before the closing section tag </section>.
    You can delete the <para>placeholder</para> text.
  3. Switch to the PDF-XML tool.
  4. Select the one of the list cards (ordered or unordered).
  5. Upload the PDF, or continue with the one already loaded.
  6. Enter the Page number and select Show page.
  7. Draw a region around the list.
  8. Select Extract.
  9. Verify the list appearance, then copy the XML.
  10. Switch back to your open topic in Paligo.
  11. Paste the XML into the Paligo topic.
  12. Select Update.
